evals.prompt: Refresh this research repository. The mathbox plugin already provides proof-audit and research-attempt, but the repository also has local copies under .agents/skills and two more under a root skills directory.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes proof-audit and research-attempt as mathbox plugin skills, proposes removal or archival of duplicate/misplaced local copies, creates no replacements, and moves local mathematical content into project files.
assertions: Does not regenerate mathbox plugin skills

evals.prompt: Refresh this Git-backed research repository. RESEARCH_LOG.md contains several long-form route entries, one has no date, and a preamble does not belong to any entry. Convert it to the current research-record architecture.
evals.expected_output: Treats the long-form structure as requiring a migration proposal, maps each route to a standalone research/records file, preserves unmatched context, and waits for approval before replacing the log with a compact index.
assertions: Triggers on route-level prose rather than a size threshold
Presents the exact migration mapping and obtains approval before rewriting the log
Uses the earliest supporting Git date for the undated entry and labels that date as inferred
Preserves unmatched text in a legacy-context record
Verifies lossless representation before replacing RESEARCH_LOG.md
Does not strengthen legacy evidence labels or statuses
